meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把任意文章或笔记快速变成一个视觉讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有文字资料想做成视频,又不想真人出镜或录屏
copy.tagline_en: Create a visual explainer video from any text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to repurpose written content into video without filming or screen capture

howto.what: 将你提供的文章、笔记或主题变成一部“无脸解说视频”——没有实拍素材，画面全是按场景设计的排版、图表和动画。Claude会生成故事板、脚本，并逐帧制作，最后输出mp4视频。
howto.when: 当你给出文字并请求做成解说视频时触发，典型用途包括主题解说、概念拆解、教程等。若意图不明会先转向/hyperframes。

say.text: 把这篇关于复利的文章做成一个3分钟的无脸解说视频
say.note: Claude会先生成故事板并核查后再逐帧制作。

say.text: 帮我解释‘区块链’概念，做一个带图表和动画的短视频
say.note: 会选定一种画面预设并写出脚本。

say.text: 把这份操作说明改成分步骤的解说视频
say.note: 会按步骤规划画面并生成视频。

howto.what_en: Turn your article, notes or topic into a “faceless explainer video” — no real footage, visuals are invented typography, charts and animation. Claude builds a storyboard, script, then frames and renders an mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide text and ask for an explainer video — typical uses: topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, etc. If unclear, it routes to /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Turn this article about compound interest into a 3-minute faceless explainer video.
say_en.note: Claude drafts a storyboard and checks it before building frames.

say_en.text: Explain 'blockchain' as a short video with charts and animations.
say_en.note: It picks a design style and generates a script.

say_en.text: Turn these operating instructions into a step-by-step explainer video.
say_en.note: It plans each step as a scene and renders the video.
